system.requirements: Training (1) or Focus (1) in Ranged Skill, a ranged weapon
system.description: Choose a Zone in weapon range and make a DN 4:1 Body (Ranged Skill) Test; each enemy there makes an Opposed DN 4:1 Body (Reflexes) Test, taking Damage equal to the difference in successes on a failure, or diving to cover and taking none if they pass.
